description: Ask the AnyForge Oracle a question about this workspace: programs, initiatives, codebases, analyzed-codebase docs, releases, recorded decisions — AND live data from the connected integrations (e.g. "top 10 payment errors in production over the last 7 days" via a connected Datadog). The Oracle runs its own multi-step research loop server-side and returns one final, source-cited answer, so ask the FULL question in one call instead of decomposing it yourself. Read-only; answers are company-scoped. A research turn can take a few minutes, so this call waits up to ~40s: if the result has status "done" it carries the answer; if it has status "running", call anyforge_get_oracle_answer with its askId (repeat while it stays "running"). Do NOT call anyforge_ask_oracle again for the same question — that starts a second turn. A turn that runs out of time is continued server-side automatically (up to maxContinuations extra turns, default 2), so long answers such as a full program brief arrive whole: keep polling rather than asking "continue". A "done" answer with investigationTruncated: true used every continuation; ask a narrower follow-up for what it left out.

context.description: Optional background the Oracle should know (what you are investigating, ids/repos already identified).

maxContinuations.description: How many extra turns the server may run if the answer is cut off by the per-turn time limit (default 2, max 3; each is billed as a turn). 0 returns the first turn's answer as is.

question.description: The complete question, in natural language. Include the time window if it matters ("last 7 days").

name: anyforge_ask_oracle
title: Ask oracle
